name: taskcut
description: Compacts at the end of a sub-task instead of when the context window fills, including in the middle of a long turn. Once the context is past a floor, a model judges each step, from the same inputs auto mode's permission classifier reads, for whether it finished a piece of the work; if it did, taskcut runs Claude Code's own compaction. Below the floor it does nothing and costs nothing.

floorPercent.title: Only past this context fill
floorPercent.description: Below this context fill taskcut does nothing at all: no model is asked and nothing is compacted. A compaction invalidates the prompt cache, so it is only worth making once the window has actually filled. Set to 0 to judge every turn.

model.title: Model that judges
model.description: Judges, past the floor, whether a step of the working model finished a piece of the work. Alias or full id, resolved the way a --model value is.
